scoring_justification: Main quantitative claims (equilibrium radii, bulk moduli) are compared to the paper’s DLM predictions with tolerances; DOS is verified by structural features because exact DOS intensities depend on the computational method and cannot be directly compared.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper’s DLM values for actinide Wigner-Seitz radii and bulk moduli digitized from Figures 1 and 2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Figure 1 and Figure 2 of the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate digitization of the DLM curves capturing the trend and values consistent with the paper’s description and the known δ‑Pu volume
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values represent the paper’s central result of improved equilibrium properties; they are approximations of the reported DLM results and serve as the hidden reference against which the agent’s re‑computation is checked.

outputs.description: Equilibrium Wigner-Seitz radii and bulk moduli for the fcc actinide series from LSDA+CPA DLM calculations.
Density of states for δ-Pu at equilibrium volume, computed from the self-consistent DLM calculation.

output_contract.notes: The verifier checks radii and bulk moduli against reference values with tolerances, and verifies DOS structural features (peak positions, bandwidth).
